comments.value: Is there a world and video link you can provide that reliably reproduces sync issues? The only thing we did with the latest update was update the back-end, so its possible that there is a new bug with the latest library.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: My world "
ROOT'S HOME ｜ ALPHA ｜ SDK3"
You can go on the "Movie Room" and select any content to play and it will have some desync problem after some moment

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: If you go into Root's Alpha world, you can recreate the issue doing what I've been doing EVERY time for the past few weeks.  Select "TVShows" > "Comedy" > "The Office".  I'm currently at Season 3, but you can select any episode.  It starts off ok, but in about 3-10 minutes it's off.  I have to pause the stream, reset the progress bar to a time a few seconds before where I paused, and then press play to re-sync.  Give it another few minutes and repeat.  If you just pause and play, it solves nothing.  Hope this helps.  I though this was just a content issue and never reported it to Root.  My bad.  :(

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: it’s any video on pretty much any world. Any time the game desyncs/lags/loads new player the audio gets further off from the video and has to be paused time rolled back and replayed as mentioned above.
@{606c4b4048fa5330900ec4d0|full_name}: Yea, any video on SDK 3 World
I too have had issues on this. Its a pain in having to Pause and rewind 20 seconds every few minuetes due to desync.
Everything is practically unwatchable in the alpha world because the sound is like a few seconds off in some cases.

Oh yeah, I used a world with your prefab in. By the end of a 30 minute video, the desync is usually roughly 6 seconds. It's actually really jarring.
Though, when I tried pausing, the audio would not resync and it would simply break for the others watching it. A bit odd.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Any update on this issue? It really bother me since there is not point for me to update my world since no one can watch any contents in my world...
A friend a mine told me that maybe a temporary fix could be to rollback the AVPro thing to the previous update
@{604b5c97ab087242111cae99|full_name}: Sadly, no, I have no update on this issue yet.
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Any Update? We need this fixed this is an issue for video players across many different worlds on avpro. This is a vrchat issue that needs fixed.
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Yes an update will be nice, since we been in trending for 1-2 weeks, almost 3 weeks and we got no answer, not even "under review"
@{604b5c97ab087242111cae99|full_name}: There's presently no update on this issue just yet.
This issue has been tracked internally and assigned a priority.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Like we mentioned in the dev stream and ill say it again we would like more transparency when it comes to internal board we want to know what you guys are working on.

@{5f7d7122a316926b4614afc1|full_name}: This issue was not marked as "Under Review" until it was under internal review. There were several updates below when people asked if there was any changes/updates regarding this issue, to which I said "No, not yet". 
When the status changed, I changed this item immediately.
Is there something else you're asking for?
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Necroing to say this is no longer the case and issue can be closed.

details: with the latest update, we're finding that videos that have had no previous issues are now not syncing properly with audio. Currently i have 5 separate reports of this.
title: [1061]AVPro Audio sync issues
